GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: Option to be ridden further forward if begins well; settled on pace. Bumped on jumping. Raced keenly in the early stages and near the 900m was eased off heels. Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat 6l off rail, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4-5l off, plodded home # poor/amiss?
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden further forward; settled back. When questioned, rdr std his intention was to settle in a prominent position as notified, however shortly after the start the mare blundered, lost ground and he was then obliged to settle at the rear of the field. Std after straightening the mare failed to respond to his riding when under pressure & in his view may not have appreciated the soft (7) track conditions. A post-race vet exam of the mare, which was beaten 22L, rev no abs. Co-tnr was told the mare will be required to barrier trial prior to racing again. Since passed trial.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased back 8-9l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 4-5l off all clear, battled on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden more conservatively; settled back. Shortly after the start was bumped and was taken behind rnrs from the outside barrier in the early stages. Raced wide and without cover from the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Four Wide , held together much same to turn 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Approaching winning post laid in and proved difficult to fully test to the line.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event. Passing the 200m was bumped. Approaching the winning post commenced to lay in and proved difficult to fully test to the line.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 3 Wide 1 length. 2nd turn 3 wide. got to front in Straight . grabbed last stride. 3 Wide trip # most unlucky

Crowded @ start. Not pushed early & raced 3rd on inside (2L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Chasing Six Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & bumped @ 200m. Weakened in last 150m. Rider - needs firmer tracks. Vetted clear. # Struggled last 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was crowded for room. Near the 150m had to be steadied after shifting in and away from a runner. Rdr reported his mount travelled well in the early and middle stages, however failed to fully let down on the heavy (9) surface and, in his view, the mare would be better suited racing on a firmer track. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.
